notes: Resident rates 2026-27 (second bracket cut to 15% from 1 July 2026), LITO up to $700, Medicare levy 2% with low-income threshold $28,011 (shade-in 10% to $35,013), HELP marginal repayment from $69,528 (15%), 17% above $129,717, capped at 10% of income from $186,051. Super guarantee 12% (employer, on top of salary). Re-checked 19 Oct 2026: the Medicare levy low-income thresholds used here ($28,011 shading in to $35,013 for a single person) are the latest the ATO publishes - they are the figures printed in the 2026 return instructions and the myTax 2026 pages, i.e. the 2025-26 amounts - and are carried into 2026-27 until the ATO publishes 2026-27 thresholds, which are set after the income year they apply to. The Medicare levy surcharge and private health insurance rebate thresholds that did rise on 1 July 2026 are not modelled here.
